name: OCKM BSS
description: Warm, round, soft bass: a rounded sine core, sub and a touch of saw into a resonant 24 dB filter you can open from dark and muffled to open and full (never fizzy). Cutoff and Decay take it from almost a kick to a full-on growl. One note at a time with optional glide, plus a bass-safe tempo-synced echo.
author: OCKM
